rules.statement: A partition decree, even if the Commissioner of Lands fails to give thirty days' notice to the public as required by section 5 of the Partition Ordinance, is not conclusively binding on all parties and third parties unless such notice was given.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the language which the Legislature has thought fit to use in providing for this notice, a general consideration of the provisions of the Ordinance, and the effect given to a final decree under section 9 strongly indicate that this is intended to be a notice to the public and is an imperative provision of the Ordinance."
